title: Resume a paused session from Home
description:
As a learner, I want to resume the session I left unfinished, so that short practice sittings add up without losing progress.

A session that has not been ended (via Leave table, E10) is the paused session; closing the app or reloading leaves it paused and does not end it (the Table-header Home control, REQ-004.9, is E02-S15). Session state is saved after every completed hand by E03-S11 and an unfinished hand is never written. Home shows Resume session only while a paused session exists, with its game type, table size, stake and hands played (e.g. "Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · 132 hands"). Resume restores game type, table size, stake, line-up (name and seat styles), seats (bot ids and names), stacks, dealer button position, hand count and speed, and deals the next hand with stacks as they were before the abandoned hand began. SNG level restore (also REQ-004.3) is verified by E05-S03 once sit-and-go exists. The abandoned hand is not counted anywhere: hand count, hand records, stats.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-002 (Must): Home screen menu — The Home screen shall offer New game, Statistics and Settings, and shall offer Resume session only while a paused session exists.
- REQ-004 (Must): Pause, resume and end a session — When the user goes Home or closes the app during a session, TLH Trainer shall keep that session as a paused session that can be resumed at the start of the next hand; when the user chooses Leave table, it shall end the session and open the Session Report.

Covers: REQ-002, REQ-004

## Notes
E05: the SNG-level resume AC (E05-S03) should also tag REQ-004.3. Leaving the table with Leave table ends the session (E10), after which Resume must not show.

Plan key: E02-S08 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a paused 6-player $4/$8 cash session with 132 completed hands, When Home is shown, Then it shows Resume session with Cash, 6 players, $4/$8 and 132 hands [REQ-002.4]
Given storage with no session or only ended sessions, When Home is shown, Then Resume session is not shown [REQ-002.5]

Given 10 completed hands and the app closed in the middle of hand 11, When the app is relaunched and the user chooses Resume session, Then the Table deals a new hand numbered 11 with every stack equal to its value at the end of hand 10 [REQ-004.2]

Given a paused 9-player $10/$20 Custom session with button at seat 7 after hand 25, When it is resumed, Then the table shows the same game type, table size, stake, line-up name, bot names and styles in the same seats, stacks and hand count 25, and the next hand's button is the seat that follows seat 7 under the button rules [REQ-004.3]

Given the app was closed in the middle of hand 11, When stored hand records and the style stats computed from them are read after resuming, Then no record of the abandoned hand exists and the stats equal those of hands 1 to 10 [REQ-004.6]
Given a resumed session, When further hands complete, Then they are stored under the same session id with hand numbers continuing from 11 [REQ-004.2]

Given a stored session whose seats include an unknown seat kind, an unknown bot style or a missing bot name, When it is loaded to resume, Then it is rejected with a clear error (not passed to resolveLineUpName/lineUpSessionConfig or the table), and Home stays usable

Given a stored session whose handsPlayed or nextBotId is at or near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, When Resume restores it, Then it is rejected with a RangeError (cap below MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) rather than producing an unsafe hand number
